review_summary: Completed a repository-grounded review of the exact base-to-head diff. The change replaces the manually managed cache file with Path.write_text so OSError failures during opening, writing, or closing are handled by the existing PytestCacheWarning path, and adds focused coverage for all three failure stages. No sufficiently supported technical issue was found. Tests were not executed because the mandated read-only environment does not permit their temporary filesystem writes.
